work.title: United Nations Development Programme UNDP
work.meta: UNDP · Digital Media Specialist · 2022 to present · New York
work.brief: Make development work on climate, crisis, the Global Goals, gender equality and poverty matter to a global audience scrolling past.
work.did:
Produced 100+ videos, photo stories and graphics. 

Manage UNDP's Instagram and Facebook pages curating and reviewing content. 

Wrote scripts, stories and blogs, and planned campaigns for advocacy efforts working with UNDP offices around the world. 

Brainstorm ideas, provide creative feedback and support teams on execution of global campaigns.

Supported UNDP’s global campaigns with creative input and execution, and worked with Goodwill Ambassadors on their content strategy and production, including Cody Simpson, Nikolaj Coster-Waldau, Michelle Yeoh, Yemi Alade and Antonio Banderas.

work.title: United Nations Development Programme India
work.meta: UNDP India · Digital Media Communications · 2019 to 2021 · New Delhi
work.brief: Build an engaged national audience for UNDP’s work in India.
work.did:
Produced multimedia content and campaigns, including videos and graphics on programme work and advocacy efforts. 

Advised and managed senior leadership social media Social Media curating and creating content on important events. 

Managed the country office website with updates and analytics on the content performance. 

Provided creative feedback and support teams on execution campaigns.

Worked with creators and celebrities on advocacy efforts, including Prajakta Koli, Sarah-Jane Dias and Lucky Ali.
work.result: Grew the social audience by 80%, to more than 250,000 followers.

work.title: #14000andCounting
work.brief: To increase awareness on children seperated from families at the border
work.did: Produced, filmed and built an art installation consisting of a 20 ft milk carton trimmed in white neon located in Venice Beach, Los Angeles with 14,000 individual milk cartons inside representing every child. Instead of talking about missing children we used the milk carton reference to talk about what they are missing out on: their homes, families, and childhoods and wrote this on every milk carton.

work.title: Fundraising documentary for Syria
work.meta: Save the Syrian Children · Content Producer · 2019 · Los Angeles
work.brief: Raise funds for medical aid inside an active war zone.
work.did: Worked with doctors in Syria to understand conditions on the ground, then scripted, produced and edited a fundraising documentary and video.

about.heading: Telling stories that matter
paragraphs: I started at a digital marketing agency, launching campaigns for Philips and fast-growing consumer brands. It taught me what makes people click, watch and share.

A master’s in New Media Storytelling at USC Annenberg took me to Los Angeles, where I produced immersive journalism for NPR, Al Jazeera, KCRW and Google, worked on advocacy campaigns at 72andSunny, and made a VR documentary that won a Webby Award.

Since 2019 I’ve been with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), starting in New Delhi and now in New York. I plan, write, shoot and edit campaigns on climate change, gender equality, poverty, crisis and digital transformation for audiences worldwide.
I work where strategy meets creativity. I write the brief, shape the idea, plan the distribution, make the film, and read the data that shows what worked.
